acceptanceCovered: save/load ordering: boss reward Aura is unlocked and saved before BossDefeated is marked and published (BossVictorySequence.Run); a kill interrupted between the two leaves the Aura owned and the boss re-fightable, no softlock

bosses, seals, chests, shortcuts and gates persist by PersistentId in GameState and re-apply on Start and on GameStateLoaded; menu return reloads Core in single mode so no stale in-session state survives New Game
corrupt, empty, wrong-version and unreadable saves never throw (SaveSystem.TryLoad, Guarded reads); valid .bak recovers a damaged main; wrong version is not replaced by .bak
event bus subscription symmetry: every EventBus.Subscribe has a matching Unsubscribe in the paired lifecycle method across Scripts/ (scripted count + lifecycle check)

pooled objects: BossHazard fully re-Configured on rent (velocity, age, armed, events, hitbox registry cleared), harmless markers never pooled, destroyed pool entries skipped; CoinPickup.Launch resets age, velocity, resting, collected
wallet: adds saturate at int.MaxValue, spends never negative, negative prices rejected, Quote gates MaxedOut/AtStatLimit before spend, shop purchase saves immediately
gating: SmoothWall excluded only from wall grip (GripsWall), applied by RoomTerrain generator; OneTimeAuraGate accepts only the matching Aura and interaction
release safety: no keystore or secrets tracked (.gitignore covers *.keystore/*.jks), BuildReleaseApk refuses without a complete custom keystore and exits 1 in batch, ARM64 IL2CPP
licensing: Art/Audio/Fonts contents match their LICENSES.md (27 SFX wav, 12 ogg generated; fonts OFL; one CC0 Kenney pack); credits text aggregates them
tools/unity-batch.sh exit code: code=$? after case captures the Unity run status (shot branch returns it via subshell), compile errors force exit 1, usage errors 64, busy editor 75
regressionChecked: GameManager OnApplicationPause save and stateSaved lifecycle
RegionLoader/RoomManager/CheckpointService coroutines tolerate disabled or destroyed rooms (null guards, room != Current check)
BossArena OnEnable/OnDisable symmetry and ResetEncounter on room unload
LightBudgetController restores only lights it suppressed and RestoreAll on disable
Haptics JNI failure falls back and latches jniBroken
file sizes: only BossBase.cs (206) and MapScreen.cs (201) exceed 200 lines

findings.summary: Burned/extinguished gate is marked opened in memory only, no gm.Save(); AuraSeal and SealGate do save. Lost if Android kills the process without OnApplicationPause. Add gm.Save() after MarkGateOpened (same for Shortcut.cs:48)
Shortcut open is not saved immediately (MarkShortcutOpened only); persists only at the next altar, boss, shop or app-pause save

If AuraManager.Instance is null the reward is skipped with a warning but MarkDefeated still runs, so the boss is gone for good and the Aura (and the gates behind it) is permanently unobtainable. UnlockReward should return bool and the sequence should not mark defeated on failure

OnApplicationPause saves for every mode but Menu, including right after StartNewGame (stateSaved false, Mode Loading/Playing): backgrounding the app before the first altar overwrites the old Continue slot with a fresh state; MainMenuScreen.StartNewGame has no overwrite confirmation. Skip the pause-save while !stateSaved && State is a fresh game, and/or confirm New Game when HasSave
No confirm dialog before New Game when a save exists
FindObjectsByType<Light2D>() allocates an array twice a second and _candidates.Contains is O(n^2); acceptable at 2 Hz but a Light2D registry (OnEnable/OnDisable) removes the scan and the GC
Summoned spiderlings use the normal StoneSpider drop table and are re-summoned whenever fewer than 2 live: coins farmable during the boss fight. Zero the drop table on summoned minions
206 lines, over the 200-line standard (MapScreen.cs is 201); move Target/properties or Validate into a partial
Two comments merged on one line with a stray // (explains recycled vs pooled); split

PlayerSettings keystore passwords are not persisted across Unity sessions, so batch release always refuses with 'password is empty'; read them from env vars (AURA_KEYSTORE_PASS etc.) and set before the check; also bump AndroidBundleVersionCode
compile/test/exec have no timeout (only shot does) so a hung Unity holds the lock forever; test does not delete Logs/test-results.xml first, so a run that dies early prints the previous run's totals

Art/UI pngs, KeyArt jpgs, TMP LiberationSans.ttf and docs/reference PDFs are not individually listed with provenance; no repo-level LICENSE file for a public repo. Confirm key art and the lecturer PDF (Tai_Lieu...v2 (1).pdf) may be published
No auto-pause on OnApplicationPause/Focus loss: returning from the background resumes live mid-fight. Pause (without screen) when the app is backgrounded in Playing mode
